svg.title: Workflow: Production planning & plant / machine optimization
svg.desc: Solution workflow (hybrid) for Production planning & plant / machine optimization: 1 trigger: Planner asks in chat, or the monthly/weekly schedule fires → planning request; 2 system: Exports from ERP, validated-batch-size system, quality-event system and validation planner load as-is into linked objects → reconciled data; 3 skill: Readiness skill checks master documents, MES recipe, open quality items, equipment requalification and materials per line → Ready / At risk / Blocked with blocker and owner; 4 skill: Batch-and-machine skill applies R1-R3 to demand and rounds to whole batches → batch sizes; 5 guardrail: Only equipment validated for the batch size and in date on requalification is used; others flagged with reason → compliant assignment; 6 skill: Groups batches sharing a blend to reduce non-serial changeovers → sequence and changeover saving; 7 decision: Any line blocked or equipment lapsed? yes → flag with source record for the owner / no → include in draft plan; 8 agent: Produces the machine-level draft plan with rationale per batch → plan pack; 9 human: Planner and quality SME review and approve; no write-back to source systems → approved plan; 10 outcome: Draft in about one hour and plan ready earlier, with zero violations → planner capacity released
